value: Held-out LOCO R² by model level under a Structural BAG target with age, sex and diagnosis already regressed out.
Residualization is per-fold and leakage-free: BAG ~ age + sex + diagnosis is refit on each LOCO fold's training countries only. Country is deliberately not in the residualization formula.
